question: When the feature-class law varies across graphs and columns, does an adaptive observed-cell factor improve classification over a sign-constrained factor, a flexible static factor and explicit law marginalization?
graph_freeze: One prespecified historical CE seed11 graph encoder and graph-factor checkpoint is frozen in every factor arm and every training seed. No checkpoint is selected by new test outcomes. Reset and train only cell functions. Public Mask/PCFI models retain their original public frozen-backbone recipe and train their adapters; they do not have the identical graph-factor architecture. Log frozen digests and prior training as reused knowledge.
graph_prior: Unchanged historical twelve-node target-helper binary SBM, two relations and Independent/Exclusive/Coupled role priors. Six density/signal values and prior masses unchanged. Graph edge/nonedge pairs fully observed. Known role-prior-family descriptor is supplied to every method; true role/density/signal are not.

feature_laws.gaussian: X|u = mu*u + sigma*Normal(0,1), u=s_i*z_f; mu in(.8,1.2), sigma in(.6,.9).
feature_laws.heavy: X|u = mu*u + sigma/sqrt(3)*StudentT(df=3), same mu/sigma supports; sigma is the finite noise standard deviation.
feature_laws.variance: X|u=+1 ~ Normal(0,sigma_plus^2), X|u=-1 ~ Normal(0,sigma_minus^2); sigma_minus in(.35,.5), sigma_plus in(1.0,1.5).
feature_laws.training: Each column independently draws one of the three laws uniformly, one of the two diagonal parameter tuples uniformly, and z_f uniformly in{-1,+1}. No law name, parameter, orientation or hidden label enters learner inputs.
feature_laws.heldout: Each column uses one of the two off-diagonal parameter tuples. Individual scalar parameter values and all three law names were seen during training; their tuples were not. This is not unseen-law generalization.

observations: Whole-node observations, exactly3/6 nodes outside label context. Reserve a target query selected without labels and exclude it from the observed set so every episode has at least one query without physical features. Context total1/2/4, never per-class. Query labels appear only in train CE and evaluation.
cell_models: Original retains x*positiveNN(abs(x),count,RMS,frozen graph embedding). Static uses a shared unrestricted rho(x); adaptive uses rho(x,S_f), where S_f contains only observed column statistics. Both flexible heads have a common trainable six-value-basis linear path and an MLP. Their initial scores equal the original1.55*x clipped to[-8,8]. Static width35 vs adaptive32 matches trainable head parameters within2%; report exact counts. No new posterior head, imputation, auxiliary loss or teacher loss.
statistics_S: Eight observed-only, node-permutation-invariant column summaries: count/N, clipped mean, clipped mean absolute value, log1p(mean square), log1p(max absolute value), fractions abs(x)<.5, abs(x)>1, abs(x)>2. Hidden entries never contribute. No context/query labels enter these summaries.
inference: Original24-step damping.5 cavity BP and same-potential Bethe role update, with gradients through cell factors and role weights. Identical graph factors frozen. Conditional structured scores, not claimed normalized generative feature likelihoods.
learning: All15 new models use identical2048 fresh train tasks, per-seed permutation,256 successful updates,batch8 and query CE on all target queries. AdamW, weight_decay.0001,clip1. Factor cell LR.001; public base LR.00003/new LR.001;16-step warmup and cosine schedule retained. Three seeds. Original public initialization, no continuation from prior feature models. Final checkpoint only, no target-graph updates.
fixed_controls: Explicitly known all3 feature laws, all4 Cartesian parameter tuples per law, uniform law/tuple/orientation prior fixed before results and identical in all evaluation cells. It never receives the actual law or tuple. Fixed-law exact and fixed-law24-step BP use the identical frozen graph potential; BP enumerates12^2 law/parameter branches with binary orientation latents and retains feature likelihood constants in joint Bethe weights. Exact variant enumerates4096 node labels and analytically sums law/parameter/orientation candidates per column. Retain both for quality/cost.
reference: Additional exact known-family reference integrates the native six graph parameters and four roles plus the same broad feature-law candidate prior. It is a normalized small-family reference, not the true OOD Bayes posterior or privileged true-parameter teacher. Report predictive KL to this reference separately from sampled-label metrics.
development: Twelve separately seeded dev graphs: four law regimes x three role-prior families, all6 context/observation settings. Use for numerical validation and finite-gradient smoke steps only, not accuracy-based architecture or loss selection. Discard smoke weights. Lock all model/config/source hashes before final training/evaluation; test bank not used for development.
final_test: 192 fresh independent base graphs:3 role-prior families x4 law regimes(Gaussian-only,heavy-only,variance-only,mixed distinct laws) x2 parameter modes(diagonal matched,off-diagonal heldout) x8 seeds. Six paired mask/context episodes per base graph:1152. Stratified law-regime evaluation, not the iid training law mixture. No law-regime or parameter-mode field enters predictors.
primary: Accuracy only on queries with no physical features, heldout parameter tuples, all4 law regimes and3 priors:96 base graphs. Average query metrics within episode, the6 episodes and the3 fixed training seeds within graph before paired base-graph bootstrap5000. Comparisons adaptive-static and adaptive-original must both have95CI lower>0. Accuracy, NLL/Brier and reference KL separate.
gaussian_guard: Pure Gaussian on all48 matched+heldout graphs: adaptive-original and adaptive-static accuracy95CI lower>-0.02 for prespecified2%p noninferiority guard. Failing to establish this guard is not proof of collapse. Report matched/heldout Gaussian separately as secondary. No multiplicity-adjusted subgroup or training-seed-population claim.
competitive_gate: After the adaptation and Gaussian guards, require either significantly higher primary accuracy than the faster explicit fixed-law exact/BP baseline at no higher measured median latency, or accuracy noninferiority within2%p and at least2x lower median latency. Report both fixed controls, public Mask/PCFI, all metrics, batch costs and memory without selecting a test-specific baseline or method. This gate does not require beating an exact Bayesian reference systematically.
cost: Visible input to probabilities, sameRTX3090,30 repetitions after5 warmups after all our workers finish. Include graph potential/statistic computation, BP or enumeration; PCFI includes imputation. Exclude loading/bank I/O. New training, development smoke, references and historical reused checkpoint costs separately recorded. External GPU load uncontrolled.
stop: No temperature, extra head/loss, more updates, test-based checkpoint or law-specific model selection if this fixed protocol fails. Preserve any static expressivity or adaptive utility effects separately; no full HeteroGraphPFN/real graph/99.5%/large graph claim.
